message.content:
We’ve got a few different types—it’s a mess. Some pads use USB-C, some use a proprietary connector from one of the drone manufacturers, and others use a different standard that’s only compatible with older models. They’re not interchangeable, so if a drone’s battery is dead and the pad doesn’t match, we’re out of luck until we can swap it out.

Sometimes, a drone will arrive at a site with a dead battery, and the pad there won’t fit. Then we have to scramble to find another pad with the right connector or call a tech to bring the right charger. It slows everything down.
